requirements.unitRule: Single unit, or any combination of matching-style cabinets at various widths, total run ≤120", maximizing the number of qualifying 25"x14"+ compartments.
requirements.storagePreference: Cabinet + adjustable shelves preferred; zero drawers preferred, minimal acceptable.
requirements.dividerRule: A door pair opening onto a single continuous bay passes; a center divider splitting it into narrower bays fails, even if overall width looks sufficient.

runnerUp.name: HAVSTA Cabinet with Base
runnerUp.shelvesNote: 1 adjustable shelf (singular — matches the passing pattern, not the divided one)

verification.source: IKEA's own page has no readable interior figure in this session's text extraction — the measurement diagram is image-only. Inferred by analogy to HAVSTA Sideboard's own published wall-offset (47.625−45.625=2"W, 18.5−15=3.5"D) applied to this SKU's identical 31.875×18.5 overall footprint.
verification.whatWouldVerify: Read the actual measurement-diagram image on the product page (needs image analysis, not text scraping), or find an assembly-instructions PDF, or a buyer review reporting the interior measurement.

runnerUp.whyMissed: Not a disqualification — a genuine coverage gap. The original research searched "HAVSTA sideboard" and IKEA's larger catalog lines but didn't separately search the "HAVSTA Cabinet with Base" product name within the same series. Flagged by the requester directly; overall footprint is dimensionally identical to the verified TONSTAD winner, and its "1 adjustable shelf" (singular) wording matches the passing pattern used elsewhere to distinguish undivided cabinets from divided ones — a good sign, not proof.
runnerUp.notes: Strongest unverified candidate found. If its interior is confirmed at or near the inferred ~29⅞"×15", it would rank alongside the verified HAVSTA Sideboard — same series, same finish, genuinely combinable as a matching-style pair (see Combination Planner).

retailerNotes.wayfair: Zero verified passes. Wayfair's own product pages returned HTTP 429 (rate-limited) on every direct-fetch attempt, so results leaned on brand sites and cross-retailer corroboration rather than Wayfair's own diagrams — thinner coverage than Amazon or IKEA got. Results were dominated by the same SimpliHome lines that fail on Amazon. Not yet checked: Wayfair's traditional solid-wood buffet lines (Birch Lane, Sunset Trading, Jofran, A-America, Powell), which typically run 19–21" deep.
